naming: sfx: assets/audio/sfx/<group>_<n>.wav with n from 1 (single sounds are <group>_1.wav); amb: assets/audio/amb/<name>.ogg; music: assets/audio/music/<name>.ogg

targets.sfx: 44.1 kHz 16-bit PCM WAV, mono (UI/stingers stereo), per-sound peak target
targets.amb: 44.1 kHz stereo OGG Vorbis, -24 LUFS, seamless loop
targets.music: 44.1 kHz stereo OGG Vorbis, -18 LUFS (combat layers -19), seamless loop unless loop=false

hit_crit.desc: critical hit: heavy layered impact with bright ring

potion.desc: cork pop, gulps, warm ember glow

level_up.desc: triumphant-but-dark swell (2-3 s): drum, low bloom, choir, rising plucks

ash_crumble.desc: enemy dissolving into ash and sparks (signature death)
